hooks.name: Spec sync on tasks.md save
hooks.description: When .kiro/specs/rest-in-tabs/tasks.md is saved, check that tasks.md, requirements.md and the code still agree, and report gaps (the same check as "Spec sync after a task").

action.prompt: .kiro/specs/rest-in-tabs/tasks.md was just saved. Check that tasks.md, requirements.md, design.md and the code still agree: (1) every acceptance criterion in requirements.md (written as N.M) is referenced by at least one task's "_Requirements:" line in tasks.md; list any criterion no task references; (2) every requirement number a task references exists in requirements.md; (3) for tasks marked [x], spot-check that the functions, files and messages they name exist in src/ (search for them); (4) any wording the task or requirement fixes (button labels, toasts, numbers such as 170 ms or 0 to 14 days) matches the code. Report gaps as a short list with file and line; say "Spec sync: no gaps" if there are none. Do not edit anything; only report.
